embeds.title: Baidu Qianfan is saving OpenRouter users $17.6K a year over CrofAI on DeepSeek V4 Flash
embeds.description:
Baidu Qianfan posts 0.0791 / 0.0158 / 0.158 against CrofAI's 0.12 / 0.003 / 0.21. On 420B tokens a week, 28% of measured traffic on this model, they bill $768.4K a year against the $785.9K the same workload would cost on CrofAI with the same 77% caching.
ℹ️ That 420B splits 22% input, 75% cached, 4% output, but spend breaks down 50% / 34% / 16% on OpenRouter vs 73% / 6% / 21% at CrofAI's current prices and caching.

footer.text: Prices per 1M tokens. Traffic from OpenRouter, week ending 2026-08-29. Annualised from one week.
